inputs.text: This is yet another blatant assault by progressive elites in France who are weaponizing the state against our most vital traditions and institutions. In Paris, Father Bernard Domini, superior of the Missionary Family of Notre-Dame, has been convicted under this new law targeting psychological subjection. This is a direct blow to social order and cultural continuity, with meddling government officials stepping in to silence religious leaders who uphold longstanding moral principles rather than the left's radical modern ideologies.
